messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

My day out runs from 09:00 until 23:10. I'm starting from Maxwell Food Centre. Money is not a concern. I definitely need to see Spectra Light and Water Show. If there's time, I'd also like Peranakan Museum, Adventure Cove Waterpark, Singapore River Cruise, Chinatown Complex Food Centre, Clarke Quay, Singapore Zoo, Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Bird Paradise, SkyHelix Sentosa and Singapore Oceanarium. I want to do Clarke Quay before Singapore River Cruise.

response: Starting at Maxwell Food Centre, I’ve got the whole day from 09:00 to 23:10 to explore. Budget isn't an issue at all.
